title: Lion in Cracked Savanna
description: A majestic male lion with a flowing mane lies on dry, cracked earth, its mouth open in a roar. Surrounding the lion are vibrant flowers, a burning flame, scattered papers, and a colorful feather, set against a barren savanna with a smoky sky and distant trees.
prompt: A majestic male lion with a golden mane lies on dry cracked earth in an African savanna, mouth open in a roar, purple flowers in its mane, a burning flame and colorful feather nearby, scattered papers on the ground, barren landscape with acacia trees and smoky sky in the background, dramatic surreal painting style
